The issuer shows only marginal short-term liquidity (current ratio 1.04) and a highly leveraged balance sheet, with liabilities equal to roughly 85% of assets and equity comparatively thin. That said, it remains profitable at the operating level and has a very large retained earnings base, which supports some resilience; overall this looks more like a lower-tier investment-grade profile than a speculative-grade one.

DECISION: BBB-
